basis: Brain malformations, seizures and profound developmental delay define disease; contractures in 2/2 and optic atrophy in 1/2 support additional involvement.
Seasonal depressive disorder; purely psychiatric disease without defined organ damage.
Alzheimer disease causes progressive cerebral neurodegeneration and dementia.
Inherited nucleoside metabolism disorder; urinary metabolite elevations do not establish kidney damage.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia and seizures define the disorder; minor digit anomalies do not establish functional skeletal damage.
Mast-cell neoplasm; infiltrative hepatomegaly, malabsorption and osteoporosis each occur in 30-79%; hepatic dysfunction is less common.
Thymic epithelial malignancy; thymus has no listed anatomical axis, and epithelial carcinoma is not an immune mechanism disorder.
Predominantly a salivary gland carcinoma; tracheobronchial origin represents a minority subtype.
Congenital connective tissue bands join the eyelids and prevent normal eye opening.
Congenital skin and hair depigmentation; white eyelashes are hair findings. Hearing, bowel and neurologic abnormalities occur in fewer than 30%.
Craniofacial dysostosis, ear malformations/hearing loss and eyelid coloboma define the syndrome; cleft palate affects 4/13 (~31%).
Congenital kidney/urinary tract malformations define disease; hearing impairment and global developmental delay each affect 2/5 (40%).
Predominantly a salivary gland carcinoma; other primary sites are minority subtypes. Perineural pain alone does not establish common neurologic dysfunction.
Direct radiation injury to brachial or lumbosacral peripheral nerve plexuses; weakness and atrophy follow nerve damage.
Umbrella of inherited ornithine metabolism defects; ocular and neurologic damage vary by subtype and are not established across the group.
Neoplastic proliferation of myeloid-lineage blood or marrow cells; additional organ damage depends on subtype.
Carcinoma arising in lung tissue following asbestos exposure.
Pasteurella bacterial infection; directly infected skin and soft tissue, usually bite-associated cellulitis, account for most presentations (>50%).
Disease of the bony vertebral column; spinal cord or nerve damage is not shared across this umbrella.
Leech infestation; attachment sites vary between internal and external forms, with no additional organ damage established in at least 30% overall.
Defined by congenital corneal endothelial dystrophy and progressive sensorineural hearing loss; both occur in 80-99%.
Inherited bilirubin metabolism/excretion disorders; common benign hyperbilirubinemias lack liver injury. Cholestatic injury and encephalopathy are subtype-specific.
Immunodeficiency with developmental delay; autoimmune cytopenias affect 75-83% and bronchiectasis 3/6 (50%). Recurrent otitis alone does not establish lasting ear damage.
Primary carcinoma of the breast axillary tail; breast tissue is outside the 13 axes.
Benign osteocartilaginous outgrowth of the distal phalanx beneath the nail; additional nail damage meeting the frequency threshold is not established.
